title: M5 stage 13: transport character kernel to the full polynomial quotient
scope: Only character transport and quotient finite-fibre kernel, using monicity alone; does not claim complete M5 counting or algorithm.

spec.name: M5.QuotientCharacter.coordinates_zero_iff
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (z : AdjoinRoot P), M5.QuotientCharacter.coordinates P hP z = 0 ↔ z = 0
queries: AdjoinRoot power basis coordinates linear equivalence
spec.guidance: Use the linear equivalence map_eq_zero_iff or injectivity and map_zero. Includes the zero-dimensional quotient P=1. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.QuotientCharacter.character_add
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector P.natDegree) (z u : AdjoinRoot P), M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam (z + u) = M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z * M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam u
queries: AdjoinRoot power basis coordinates linear equivalence
spec.guidance: Unfold quotient value, rewrite coordinates map_add, and apply the already accepted M5.Character.character_add. Do not reprove the binary character lemma. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.QuotientCharacter.character_orthogonality
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (z : AdjoinRoot P), (∑ lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector P.natDegree, M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z) = if z = 0 then (2 : ℤ) ^ P.natDegree else 0
queries: AdjoinRoot power basis coordinates linear equivalence
spec.guidance: Unfold quotient value, apply imported M5.Character.character_orthogonality, and rewrite its zero test using coordinates_zero_iff. No quotient Fintype instance is needed; the sum is over binary coordinate characters. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.QuotientCharacter.finite_fibre_count
spec.statement: ∀ (P : M5.BinaryPolynomial) (hP : P.Monic) (n : ℕ) (f : Fin n → AdjoinRoot P) (z : AdjoinRoot P), (∑ lam : M5.Character.BinaryVector P.natDegree, M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam z * ∑ u : Fin n, M5.QuotientCharacter.value P hP lam (f u)) = (2 : ℤ) ^ P.natDegree * ((Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => f u = z)).card : ℤ)
queries: AdjoinRoot power basis coordinates linear equivalence
spec.guidance: Apply imported M5.Character.finite_fibre_count to coordinates ∘ f and coordinates z. Identify the filter predicates via linear-equivalence injectivity. Reuse the accepted count directly: this target is independent of the other new targets. Includes n=0 and P=1; there is no division or positive-degree assumption. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by; preserve the exact target.
